items.q: Vasopressin is added in septic shock mainly for which advantage?
o: Catecholamine sparing V1 vasoconstriction as second pressor
items.exp: Vasopressin restores vascular tone through V1 receptors when adrenergic responsiveness fades, reducing noradrenaline dose requirements, though mortality superiority over noradrenaline alone is unproven.
r: Incorrect. It has no airway action.
Correct. Second pressor through a different receptor.
Incorrect. Antibiotics and source control kill bacteria.
Incorrect. It neither sedates nor relieves pain.
items.kp: Second septic pressor works through vasopressin receptors.

items.q: Milrinone differs from dobutamine most importantly how?
o: Phosphodiesterase 3 inhibition causing inotropy plus vasodilation, kidney cleared
items.exp: Milrinone raises cyclic AMP downstream of receptors, strengthening contraction while dilating pulmonary and systemic vessels, useful in beta blocked or pulmonary hypertensive failure but hypotensive and accumulated in renal failure.
r: Incorrect. It dilates rather than constricts vessels.
Correct. Inodilator, phosphodiesterase based, renal cleared.
Incorrect. Beta blockade would weaken the pump.
Incorrect. It is an intravenous critical care drug.
items.kp: Milrinone: stronger pump, looser vessels, kidney cleared.

items.q: Which drug pair in pulmonary hypertension must never be combined due to profound hypotension?
items.exp: Riociguat directly stimulates soluble guanylate cyclase while PDE5 inhibitors block cGMP breakdown; together they synergise into dangerous hypotension and are contraindicated, unlike cross pathway combinations that are encouraged.
r: Incorrect. Endothelin plus PDE5 is a standard combination.
Correct. Same pathway duplication is forbidden.
Incorrect. Endothelin plus prostacyclin pathways combine legitimately.
Incorrect. Prostacyclin plus endothelin blockade is guideline combination.
items.kp: Two cGMP boosters together collapse pressure.

items.q: Bosentan therapy requires regular monitoring chiefly of what?
items.exp: Endothelin antagonists cause dose dependent transaminase rises and anaemia and are teratogenic, so liver tests, haemoglobin and strict contraception accompany bosentan especially.
r: Incorrect. Thyroid surveillance belongs to amiodarone.
Correct. Liver monitoring gates bosentan.
Incorrect. Calcium is not its toxicity axis.
Incorrect. Eye field testing belongs to other drugs.

items.q: Epoprostenol infusion interruption in severe PAH is dangerous mainly because what?
o: Rebound pulmonary hypertension and right ventricular collapse within minutes
items.exp: Continuous prostacyclin with a minutes short half life sustains pulmonary dilation; pump failure or line disruption removes it abruptly, rebounding pressures onto an unprepared right ventricle fatally, so backup systems are mandatory.
r: Incorrect. Dependence psychology is not the danger.
Correct. Rebound collapse follows interruption.
Incorrect. Liver injury is endothelin blocker territory.
Incorrect. Kidneys suffer secondarily from low output.
items.kp: Never let the prostacyclin pump stop unplanned.

items.q: Only a minority of PAH patients suit high dose calcium blockers because treatment requires demonstrating what?
items.exp: True vasodilator responders identified by acute nitric oxide challenge at right heart catheterisation (large pressure fall without output fall) are the minority who thrive on calcium blockers; others worsen without targeted therapy.
r: Incorrect. Left heart disease defines group 2, different management.
Correct. Proven vasoreactivity selects calcium blocker candidates.
Incorrect. Liver disease complicates drug choices oppositely.
Incorrect. Pregnancy forbids several PAH drugs instead.
items.kp: Calcium blockers in PAH need a positive vasoreactivity test.

items.q: In cardiogenic shock after infarction, the intervention that most changes survival alongside pressors is what?
o: Urgent revascularisation of the culprit artery
items.exp: Reopening the infarct artery restores pump muscle and is the proven survival intervention in infarct cardiogenic shock; vasoactive drugs only bridge to reperfusion and support.
r: Incorrect. Dopamine adds arrhythmic harm.
Correct. Reperfusion saves the pump and patient.
Incorrect. Pure afterload burdens the failing ventricle.
Incorrect. Flooding a failing pump worsens pulmonary oedema.
items.kp: Pressors bridge; reperfusion rescues cardiogenic shock.

items.q: Overfilling a failing right ventricle harms the left ventricle mainly through what mechanism?
o: Septal shift (ventricular interdependence) reducing left filling
items.exp: The shared septum and pericardium mean right dilation bows the septum leftward, strangling left ventricular filling and output, so right failure fluids are cautious and guided dynamically.
r: Incorrect. Steal is a coronary vasodilator concept elsewhere.
Correct. Septal interdependence strangles the left side.
Incorrect. Overfill raises, not lowers, pulmonary pressures.
Incorrect. Reflex slowing is not the filling mechanism.
items.kp: Too much right side fluid crushes the left through the septum.

items.q: Terlipressin helps hepatorenal syndrome and variceal bleeding through which receptor action?
o: V1 splanchnic vasoconstriction reducing portal pressure
items.exp: V1 mediated splanchnic arterial constriction reduces portal inflow and pressure, controlling variceal bleeding and improving renal perfusion pressure gradients in hepatorenal physiology with albumin.
r: Incorrect. Water retention is desmopressin's V2 job.
Correct. Splanchnic squeeze lowers portal pressure.
Incorrect. It has no beta cardiac drive.
Incorrect. Endothelin blockers treat pulmonary hypertension.
items.kp: Terlipressin squeezes the splanchnic bed to decompress portal flow.

items.q: Shock resuscitation success is best judged bedside by which set beyond blood pressure?
o: Lactate clearance, urine output, capillary refill and mentation
items.exp: Perfusion endpoints reveal tissue recovery that pressure numbers can mask, so lactate trends, urine flow, refill, mentation and mottling guide ongoing resuscitation quality in modern shock care.
r: Incorrect. Normal pressure can hide dying tissues.
Correct. Perfusion markers judge real recovery.
Incorrect. Lines deliver therapy but prove nothing alone.
Incorrect. Saturation misses flow and extraction failure.
items.kp: Treat tissues, not just the pressure trace.
